Maintaining the Yinyang formation Skill

Yinyang is a philosophical and literary example for developing with generative intelligence. It connects a person's understanding of themselves, a model counterpart, and their relationship with the environments in which they act. This file guides maintenance of that example; it is not another statement of all its philosophical claims.

The core views own the numbered propositions. The essays develop their arguments, images, examples, and sources. SKILL.md owns ordinary invocation and connects ordinary use of the six files. Philosophy and models explains their relationship; writing directions belong to the six public how-to guides, corresponding to six private actual files. Use the reading map to locate the argument relevant to a change.

Source and consumer roles

This package is one member of Prometheus2Heraclitus. Other Skills retain their own purposes and methods. Yinyang articulates the author's worldview and life direction, develops situated understanding of the participants and their relationship, and supplies methods for forming accounts and adapting environments. Its ontological and epistemic distinctions can be borrowed beyond this personal philosophy. Specialist Skills contribute domain knowledge and procedures; Yinyang's own methods connect the personal understanding with their actual use.

Keep the following uses of writing distinct:

  • Reader essays develop a question into an argument. Each needs enough orientation to stand alone, while links lead to a genuinely different or deeper question rather than replacing a missing premise.
  • Philosophy and models connects the six writing objects. Their guides explain how understanding becomes a situated account and a working environment. They should use the philosophy without repeating its complete exposition.
  • Situated accounts and personal context state the relevant understanding, evidence, conditions, and implications explicitly for model use. Follow the writing method; maintain correspondence with human-readable philosophy without making its literary form the default for working instructions.
  • Maintenance instructions locate sources, dependencies, publication, and acceptance. They preserve meaning across consumers without turning the essays into a second policy manual.

The package guide owns the shared/situated structure and projection contract. There are six public how-to guides under references/formation/{orientation,person,counterpart,relationship,environment,revision}.md, with complete Chinese editions, and six corresponding private actual files under references/situated/. Full initial reading uses all six actual files. The actual revision file states the recipient's method; its public guide explains how to write that method and is not an initial-reading substitute. Person, counterpart, and relationship remain three modeling objects; orientation, environment, and revision supply direction, realization, and continuing change. Private evidence at references/personal/sources.md supports the actual files, outside the initial reading. Public distribution contains neither private tree. Common projection preserves both private trees; owners migrate meaning and verify their actual consumers. Other authors can change the structure and philosophy; maintenance of this implementation retains the six-guide/six-actual distinction.

Authored public content lives here. plugins/yinyang/, website reading editions, and local/cloud common files are generated or synchronized consumers, not independent authoring sources. All essays in the website's philosophical collection and its practical getting-started guide are authored here. The native Site owns presentation code. Follow the actual source owner when a change crosses these boundaries.

Interpret the connected account

Reverse alignment is the developmental purpose: a person cultivates understanding, judgment, generation, and action through encounters with generative models. A completed output, an improved arrangement, and growth in the person's available capacities support different claims. Development may include abilities internalized by the person or reliably distributed across supports; assess the relevant change through actual participation.

Modest naturalism names the framework's scope in one changing natural world; its contemporary fire monism articulates that world's dynamic unity. This is the physical ground of philosophy, psychology, and engineering. Computational ontology is representation. This framework constructs a process ontology using represented objects, events, states, relations, constraints, and transitions. Its subjects can be actual people and psychological activity, hypothetical situations, or fictional objects. The physical realization of representing does not settle the existence of its referents. Factual claims use ordinary correspondence with what is the case; satisfaction and inference under an interpretation are distinct questions, available to either participant. Person and language model form and revise the question, model, realization, and interpretation of feedback together; their contributions are distributed throughout the same chain. Usable representations connect meanings to actual consumers and observations, including through clear model-interpreted language where appropriate. Records and models do not exhaust the activity being understood. Event streams represent activity histories; conceptual person and counterpart models are inferred and constructed from these histories and other relevant materials. Neither participant is identical with an event stream. World, process, and expression owns the developed connection. Physical dependence, particular realization mechanisms, full reduction, and feasible computation remain distinct questions. The Trinity essay connects the three physically realized activities; its local environment, repository, and website are practical forms of the work.

The adopted process ontology develops Heraclitean fire, becoming, and opposition. Its contemporary commitment and the disputed historical interpretation of Heraclitus remain distinguishable. The preferred repair analogy uses coherent working concepts while retaining conflicting sources and candidates. Selection among views and inference from them have different responsibilities. Keep the formal examples' actual assumptions and conclusions with their owning arguments; ordinary collaboration does not require constructing a repair calculus.

Sun and Moon express differentiated generation, reception, and shaping. Person and model are the actual participants and exceed those roles; either can reason, generate, object, or revise. Earth names the material and shared environment where creations acquire independent consequences. Cultivation concerns developing generative capacity, not becoming a celestial character. The Taiji essay owns the image and its philosophical sources.

Individual-first gives the person's purposes, agency, and chosen development priority in their own practice while preserving other participants' purposes. Changing social arrangements, then software, before asking the person to adapt is a design direction. Its value is judged in the actual situation. The chosen daily rhythm is ordinarily synchronous with the model and asynchronous with society, with temporary translation and alignment for social evaluation. Local cultivation and restrained promotion serve concrete lives and relations; they are not an empirical law of social acceleration.

Literary programming uses characters, images, and narrative to organize a relationship that instructions and tools can realize. The sinthome essay names a concrete personal practice-form produced through philosophy, psychology, and engineering together. The general Trinity concerns three activities within one physical reality; a person's philosophy, psychological activity, and engineering arrangements instantiate that relation. Personal materials inform partial person/counterpart models, whose representation and realization under current technical conditions give the named form its content. It participates in life without representing the entirety of that life. Philosophical exposition, bounded conceptual formalization, event-record practices, and the Skill express and realize connected aspects of this work; keep their actual contributions intelligible without treating them as unrelated projects. These are interpretive constructions with practical consequences. Their coherence does not establish a psychological diagnosis, a hidden model mechanism, or an empirical claim; such claims need their own evidence.

These distinctions preserve the argument's load-bearing relations. Their developed explanations belong in the essays, not in repeated prefaces or closing disclaimers throughout the package.

Revise for standalone and collective coherence

Read a piece for its actual question, premises, movement, examples, and result. Remove repetition that contributes no new relation. Expand where an unfamiliar concept, inference, or change of scale would otherwise leave the reader behind. A short piece can be complete; a difficult argument may need sustained detail. Neither uniform length nor preservation of every existing paragraph is a goal.

Across pieces, assign the developed argument to its clearest owner. An umbrella essay may give a short connective account; a method may state the principle it needs; a core view may state the proposition. Their different roles justify some recurrence, but each occurrence should do identifiable work. Use stable terms where the relation stays the same, and explain a material change of sense.

Words, headings, examples, and argument structure can change. Stable YY IDs remain locators for the same claims; when moving or renaming a section, repair its incoming links or retain a useful anchor. Reconcile the corresponding diagram, method, source summary, and reading route when its meaning changes. A substantive revision can also make an old caveat, example, or auxiliary rule unnecessary.

Keep English and Chinese editions semantically complete and aligned. English is the primary model-facing edition; Chinese is a full reader edition. Chinese prose uses 「…」 and nested 『…』 for marked expressions, preserving quotations, code, mathematics, and exact source material. Use recognizable current article titles in links. A bilingual website should lead each reader to the matching language where available.

Evidence, sources, and release

Attribute a borrowed philosophical concept near its use, with a useful source locator. Distinguish what the source establishes from this collection's interpretation or extension. Preserve the assumptions of formal claims and the conditions of empirical comparisons. A working URL establishes access, not substantive correspondence.

Personal claims must be grounded in attributable expression, relevant experience, and actual use. Formation does not require a complete biography. The Philosophy and models owns how to develop and revise the situated account; Environment writing guide owns carrying it into an environment and learning from the result. Use host policy for model selection, authority, and publication rather than maintaining a second routing menu here.

The public package supplies reusable guidance and philosophy, never a copied private portrait. Keep personal records, health and relationship details, private paths, conversation identifiers, and unpublished manuscripts with their private owners. General ideas can become standalone public exposition; original private materials need their actual publication authorization.

Yinyang's original material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 under LICENSE. Preserve third-party notices and source-specific rights. Package membership does not extend that license to separately licensed tools or media.

Before release, compare the intended semantic change with the integrated reader and method texts. Check affected local links, bilingual meaning, diagram relationships, and callable package interfaces. Regenerate consumers from the authoritative source, then verify publication and actual retrieval. Source equality establishes delivery; successful use and continuing collaboration supply further evidence about fit.
